name: Vecsés (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Vecsés: a blue shield with a white cross and a red letter V, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
